ValidationRule.description: Validate Account Name lenght is not longer than 35 characters
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT($Setup.PMC_ProcessSwitches__c.PMC_BypassValidationRule__c), $Profile.Name <> 'System Administrator', $Profile.Name <> 'Administrador do sistema', $Profile.Name <> 'API Only profile', NOT(CONTAINS($Profile.Name, "Master Data")), LEN( Name ) > 35 )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Account Name should not exceed 35 characters.
